word: Good morning. My wife and I are looking for an apartment.
translation: Bom dia. Minha esposa e eu estamos procurando um apartamento.
pronunciation: /ɡʊd ˈmɔːrnɪŋ maɪ waɪf ænd aɪ ɑːr ˈlʊkɪŋ fɔːr æn əˈpɑːrtmənt/
portuguesePhonetic: [gûd MÓR-nin. mái uáif énd ái ár LÛ-kin fór én â-PÁRT-mânt]

word: We’d like to see the apartment tomorrow morning.
translation: Gostaríamos de visitar o apartamento amanhã pela manhã.
pronunciation: /wiːd laɪk tuː siː ði əˈpɑːrtmənt təˈmɑːroʊ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
portuguesePhonetic: [uíd láik tú sí di â-PÁRT-mânt tâ-MÓ-rôu MÓR-nin]

word: Is the apartment near a subway station?
translation: O apartamento fica perto de uma estação de metrô?
pronunciation: /ɪz ði əˈpɑːrtmənt nɪr ə ˈsʌbweɪ ˈsteɪʃən/
portuguesePhonetic: [íz di â-PÁRT-mânt nír â SÂB-uêi STÊI-shân]

word: How much is the rent per month?
translation: Quanto custa o aluguel por mês?
pronunciation: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə rɛnt pɜːr mʌnθ/
portuguesePhonetic: [ráu mâtch iz dâ rént pâr mânth]

translation: As despesas de água e eletricidade estão incluídas?

word: Can we see the apartment before signing the lease?
translation: Podemos visitar o apartamento antes de assinar o contrato?
pronunciation: /kæn wiː siː ði əˈpɑːrtmənt bɪˈfɔːr ˈsaɪnɪŋ ðə liːs/
portuguesePhonetic: [kén uí sí di â-PÁRT-mânt bi-FÓR SÁI-nin dâ lís]

word: If we like the apartment, we’re going to talk to the landlord.
translation: Se gostarmos do apartamento, vamos falar com o proprietário.
pronunciation: /ɪf wiː laɪk ði əˈpɑːrtmənt wɪr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tuː tɔːk tuː ðə ˈlændlɔːrd/
portuguesePhonetic: [íf uí láik di â-PÁRT-mânt, uír GÔU-in tú tók tú dâ LÉND-lórd]

word: Could you tell us which documents we need to provide?
translation: Poderia nos explicar quais documentos precisamos apresentar?
pronunciation: /kʊd juː tɛl ʌs wɪtʃ ˈdɑːkjumənts wiː niːd tuː prəˈvaɪd/
portuguesePhonetic: [kûd iú tél âs uítch DÓ-kiu-mânts uí níd tú prâ-VÁID]

word: If we like the apartment, we’ll sign the lease.
translation: Se gostarmos do apartamento, vamos assinar o contrato.
pronunciation: /ɪf wiː laɪk ði əˈpɑːrtmənt wiːl saɪn ðə liːs/
portuguesePhonetic: [íf uí láik di â-PÁRT-mânt, uíl sáin dâ lís]

word: Could you tell us if utilities are included in the rent?
translation: Poderia nos dizer se as despesas estão incluídas no aluguel?
pronunciation: /kʊd juː tɛl ʌs ɪf juːˈtɪlɪtiz ɑːr ɪnˈkluːdɪd ɪn ðə rɛnt/
portuguesePhonetic: [kûd iú tél âs íf iu-TÍ-li-tiz ár in-KLÚ-did in dâ rént]
